parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description:
The ID of the required bandwidth plan. When you specify a replacement bandwidth plan, take note of the following items:

*   Only a bandwidth plan that is not associated with a GA instance can be specified.
*   If you want to replace a basic bandwidth plan, make sure that the bandwidth provided by the replacement bandwidth plan is not less than the total bandwidth allocated to the acceleration area.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: TargetBandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the bandwidth plan that you want to replace.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga replace-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp176neb61yhcymow0000 --target-bandwidth-package-id gbwp-o978hgeb61yhcymow0000 --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
